digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today's dashboard shows no newly completed checklist items, while Monday opens with overlapping Amazon Connect, Attorney Review, and portfolio commitments. The carry-forward remains focused on deadline-sensitive reviews and launch readiness.

items.label: Send the lawsuit-readiness documents
items.detail: Kris requested relevant process maps, SOPs, policies, training materials, and supporting files. The request was due today, so confirm that the useful OneDrive and shared-folder locations were sent.

items.label: Lock Monday's Amazon Connect retest readiness
items.detail: Confirm the Saturday fix-validation owner, participant coverage, and go/no-go evidence before Denver testing begins Monday at 12:30 PM.

items.label: Resolve the Attorney Review routing and readiness risk
items.detail: Validate the routing behavior, keep Jill aligned on any October 15 timeline impact, and close the outstanding Loom-video dependency before Monday's check-in.

items.label: Secure Legal review capacity for EKM scripts
items.detail: Confirm the Legal owner, capacity, and prioritization so the growing review queue does not delay the EKM migration or Agentforce work next week.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: All five reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time and collect prior-manager input before next week's compressed calendar puts the deadline at risk.

items.label: Resolve the overdue Q3 Legacy Award nomination
items.detail: Verify whether the nomination was submitted; if not, ask the program owner whether a late entry can still be accepted.

items.label: Set the next steps for the new intake work
items.detail: Confirm priority, ownership, and the first deliverable for the Universal Intake Questions revamp and Do Not Contact Banners work after today's scoping discussion.

items.label: Close the outstanding document-access decisions
items.detail: Process Vanessa Silva's T Visa, U-Visa, and DACA deck requests together, and confirm the correct permission level for Tomas Aparicio's SOP request.

items.label: Confirm the NTA SMS production result and next handoff
items.detail: Verify the production test and deployment outcome, then assign any remaining appointment-reminder review or release work during Laura's leave.

items.label: Close the Legal Request Tool notification gap
items.detail: Confirm whether the incomplete live-tool email is expected behavior or a configuration issue, and route a defect if required information is still missing.

items.label: Salesforce Program Standup series was canceled
items.detail: Nadia canceled the series and will use the Executive Status Report and SaltClick reports to update Monday's steering-committee brief.

items.label: EPMO management meeting was skipped
items.detail: Jean agreed in the meeting chat that today's session could be skipped.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Timecards and weekly preparation
items.detail: Clear payroll exceptions and use the opening block to prepare for the day's delivery meetings.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Use the checkpoint to confirm the weekend fix and readiness for the Denver retest.

items.label: 12:30-2:30 PM - Denver retest overlaps two reviews
items.detail: The Amazon Connect retest overlaps the 1:30 PM Attorney Review check-in and the 2:00 PM BD Portfolio Review, so assign coverage before the day starts.

items.label: 2:30-3:30 PM - Lead-intake alignment and a 3:00 PM conflict
items.detail: Cross-firm Lead Intake runs at 2:30 PM, followed by simultaneous Amazon readiness and Maria 1:1 meetings at 3:00 PM. Decide attendance and coverage in advance.
